description: This file defines the AnalyticsController class with an 'overview' method that handles HTTP requests to provide analytics data related to user habits and completions. It interacts with a database via external query functions and exports the controller instance.

classes.name: AnalyticsController
classes.description: A class that handles analytics-related HTTP request logic for habit tracking, including retrieving overview statistics such as active habits, completions, and top habits within a date range.

methods.name: overview(req, res, next)
methods.description: An asynchronous method that processes request parameters, performs multiple database queries to gather analytics data for habits and completions within a specified date range, and returns the results in JSON format.
